terminal_reason: ScienceBase metadata exposes the study data only as one XLSX payload, Amphibian_monitoring_data_from_the_Willamette_Valley_Oregon_2004-2015.xlsx (42,600 bytes). No separate attached site-registry, survey-effort, or detection table and no child data items are exposed. The prospectively frozen Gate0 required a physically separate route to complete site registry plus survey availability before any biological detection payload. Opening the workbook merely to inspect non-response sheets would consume the same physical bytes that contain response and is therefore forbidden.
forbidden_repairs: Do not open the XLSX and then claim only a non-response sheet was used pre-response.
Do not reconstruct the site universe from response-bearing workbook rows.
Do not relabel a repaired attempt on this same physical workbook as fresh.
